== Name
nested-fonts - combined PDF font styles

== Description

*BoldLeft _BothOne_ BoldRight* PlainEnd.

_ItalicLeft *BothTwo* ItalicRight_ PlainEnd.

`MonoLeft *MonoBold* _MonoItalic_ *_MonoBoth_* MonoRight` PlainEnd.

*BoldOuter `MonoInBold` BoldTail* PlainEnd.

_ItalicOuter `MonoInItalic` ItalicTail_ PlainEnd.

**BoldWide __BothWide__ BoldWideTail** PlainEnd.

*BoldLink link:https://example.org[_LinkBoth_] BoldLinkTail* PlainEnd.

`MonoLink *link:https://example.org/code[_CodeLinkBoth_]* MonoLinkTail` PlainEnd.

`MonoTarget [#styled]*BoldTarget _BothTarget_ TargetTail* MonoTargetTail` PlainEnd.

`Empty [#empty]*{blank}* after` PlainEnd.

`Literal . # <tag> {text} \path` PlainEnd.

Footnote footnote:note[*NoteBold _NoteBoth_ NoteTail*].
